unitTitle: Travel across the city and beyond
title: Grammar: Give or ask something to a person: lui and leur
subtitle: A2 · Unit 9: Travel across the city and beyond

steps.title: Give or ask something to a person: lui and leur
steps.body: French can avoid repeating a person or a place. First identify what the verb is connected to: lui or leur refers to a person after a verb used with à; y refers to a previously named place with common location patterns.

steps.title: Read these useful travel forms aloud, then reuse one in a new route. They support the role-play; the target grammar remains the person and place pronouns.
rows: Tu demandes le quai à Nadia ?
Are you asking Nadia for the platform?
Are you giving Karim the address?
The travellers are reading the notice.
Le service habituel ne passe pas; une autre ligne le remplace.
The usual service does not run; another line replaces it.
They are waiting at the intersection.
Ils montent dans le train et rejoignent le groupe.
They get on the train and meet the group.

steps.title: Lui is singular for a man or a woman. Leur is plural. Both go before the conjugated verb; with aller + infinitive, put the pronoun before the infinitive.
rows: Je demande le quai à Nadia.
Je donne le plan aux voyageurs.
Je vais expliquer le trajet à Nadia.
Je vais lui expliquer le trajet.

steps.title: Give or ask something to a person: lui and leur
steps.body:
• Use lui for one person and leur for more than one person when the taught verb takes à before that person: demander à, donner à, expliquer à.
• The pronoun replaces the person, not the thing: in Je lui donne l'adresse, lui means the person and l'adresse is what is given.
• Place it before the verb: je lui demande; je leur réponds. With a near-future verb: je vais lui demander.
• Do not choose lui by gender. One man or one woman both use lui; a group uses leur.

steps.prompt: Je donne le plan à Nadia. Je ___ donne le plan.
steps.explain: Nadia is one person; use lui.

steps.prompt: Je vais expliquer la route aux voyageurs. Je vais ___ expliquer la route.
steps.explain: Aux voyageurs is plural, so use leur before expliquer.

steps.prompt: What does lui replace in Je lui demande le quai?
steps.explain: Le quai is the information; lui is the person receiving the question.
